Pairing golden vectors (handshake spec §3, §7.1, §7.2; v1). code_hash = SHA-256 of the canonical code (typed text upper-cased, dashes and spaces dropped, I and L read as 1, O as 0: 10 Crockford characters, ASCII). secret_hash = SHA-256 of the QR secret's 16 decoded bytes (not its base64 text). The proof of possession is ES256 (raw r||s, base64url) by the routine key over pop_message: "AINKRAD-PAIR-V1
" + core_fp + "
" + base64url(credential hash) + "
" + fp(routine key) + "
" + (fp(step-up key) or "-"), with no trailing newline. sas = the first 16 upper-case Crockford characters (5-bit groups, most significant first) of SHA-256("AINKRAD-SAS-V1" || core_spki || device_spki || pairing_id as UTF-8), grouped XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX. Signatures are randomised: verify them, never expect to reproduce them. core_pkcs8 and device_pkcs8 are throwaway TEST keys made for this file: never use them for anything else.
